issue_context.title: Crash when opening log folder
issue_context.body:
**Explain the bug**
As the title says another thing is that the log files rapidly appear and disappear before crashing.

**To reproduce**
1. Go to Settings
2. Click on About
3. Click on Open logs
4. Wait a bit
5. see "Something when wrong" notifications 

**Expected behaviour**
Shouldn't crash

**Logfile**
[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/6721993/debug.log)
[debug_fulltrust.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/6721994/debug_fulltrust.log)

**System Information**
 - OS Version: Windows 10 21H1 19043.1088
 - App version: v1.5,46
comments: This issue should be resolved in `main`.

review_comments: Great work. Can you explain how ManualResetEventSlim would improve things here?
